503.description: The instance cannot serve; the body says why

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: The session of a person signed in through `/api/auth`, the mount owned by the sign-in library. Over HTTPS the browser carries the cookie as `__Secure-better-auth.session_token`. A changing request with this cookie must come from the instance's own origin or an allowed one.

sessionToken.description: A session token a trusted backend obtained for one of its users from `session_tokens.issue`.

accessToken.description: A short-lived access token of a service principal, obtained from `access_tokens.exchange` with an API key.

apiKey.description: An API key of a service principal. It is presented only to `access_tokens.exchange`.

serverCredential.name: x-server-credential
serverCredential.description: The instance's server credential, held by a trusted backend.

Unauthenticated.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: No credential was presented, or the credential is not valid.

Forbidden.description: `FORBIDDEN`: The caller lacks the scope or the right this operation requires.

NotFound.description: `NOT_FOUND`: The resource does not exist, is not visible to the caller, or the instance runs without this operation.

Conflict.description: `CONFLICT`: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

ValidationFailed.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: Path, query or body do not match the operation's schema.

RateLimited.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: The caller sent too many requests of this operation's rate class. `details.retryAfterSeconds` and the `Retry-After` header give the seconds to wait. The numbers are the instance's, set under `rateLimits` in its release config.

Internal.description: `INTERNAL`: The instance failed. The message never carries details.
